name: Salinas, Ecuador

rent.notes: Salinas 2BR condos $600-1,000 (better deals March-November), 2BR ~$500 in older data; pet-friendly 2-3BR for a large dog pushes typical to mid-range.

sources.title: Escape From USA - Cost of Living in Ecuador (2026)
Expat Exchange - Cost of Living in Salinas
Jobicy - Cost of living Salinas, Ecuador (May 2026)

groceries.notes: Couple basket from $30-45/wk per person (market + Tia) to $45-65/wk (Supermaxi); 100 lb dog food included as an allowance at the upper part of the range, not separately verified.

sources.title: Escape From USA - Cost of Living in Ecuador (2026)

utilities.notes: Coastal electricity $40-80/mo for a 1BR with AC (larger home with AC higher), water $5-15; jobicy cites $20-30 elec+water without AC, doubling with AC. Internet excluded.

sources.title: Escape From USA - Cost of Living in Ecuador (2026)
Jobicy - Cost of living Salinas, Ecuador (May 2026)

healthcare.notes: IESS voluntary affiliation 2026 minimum $84.83 (17.6% of $482 SBU) plus 3.41% spouse extension = ~$101 for the couple (min, IESS only); typical adds a local private plan (~$200 for two, cf. BMI quote $187 for a 53-year-old couple, local insurers $60-150 pp); max adds international cover (BUPA $120-280 pp at 60).

insurance.notes: Old-template value (180) meant health insurance and is now carried in healthcare; this is a small contents-insurance placeholder, not verified (search budget exhausted).

transportation.notes: One car: gasoline ~$0.84/L (Oct 2026, ~100 L/mo ~ $85), insurance $400-900/yr, plates/registration $80-150/yr, small maintenance allowance; min is car-free taxis (~$30/mo per person in Salinas).

medicalOOP.notes: Private GP visits $25-50 and specialists $40-80; IESS in-network care has $0 copay, so OOP is mainly private visits and plan deductibles.
